de_locator.title: Coffee House Suche - Details - Braunschweig Damm 22 | Starbucks
de_locator.facts: Damm 22, 38100 Braunschweig. Mo-Fr 08:00-20:00, Sa 09:00-20:00, So 11:00-18:00. Lists Wi-Fi, reward redemption, mobile ordering.

oezb.title: Starbucks Coffee in Braunschweig | Öffnungszeitenbuch
oezb.facts: Lists Bohlweg 74-75 (Schloss Arkaden) as current address, plus Kohlmarkt 18 nearby. Stale relative to official locator.

offennet.title: Starbucks in Braunschweig | Offen.net
offennet.facts: Lists Kohlmarkt 18 and Bohlweg 74 as the two Innenstadt locations. No hours, no Damm 22.

tonline.title: Braunschweig: Starbucks eröffnet Filiale in der Innenstadt
tonline.facts: Starbucks fully left Braunschweig ~5 years before Dec 2024; prior stores Kohlmarkt (~10 yrs, closed) and Schloss-Arkaden (closed 2016); new ~200 sqm store opens early Dec 2024 on Damm pedestrian zone; reasoning paraphrased re: site potential and Braunschweig as Lower Saxony's 2nd-largest city.
